svg.title: What travels with a ReView deployment, and under which licence
svg.desc: Three layers are redistributed together: ReView's own code under the AGPL, 605 npm production dependencies inside the images, and the operating-system programs baked into the backend image. The database, cache, object store and proxy run in separate containers over the network and keep their own licences.
svg.text: an SPDX header in every scanned file — see the coverage table on the page
the frontend image also serves /LICENSE and /THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md as plain text
npm production dependencies, shipped inside the images
MIT 463 · Apache-2.0 62 · ISC 60 · BSD-3-Clause 10 · 0BSD 2 · MPL-2.0, OFL-1.1, CC0-1.0 and five others once each
notices preserved verbatim; the generator refuses any licence off the allow-list
OS programs baked into the backend image
always: ffmpeg (GPL-2.0+) · assimp-utils · fonts-dejavu-core · openssl · ca-certificates · dos2unix
opt-in: Blender + usd-core (INSTALL_USD_TOOLS=1) · guc (GUC_URL) — republish and you pass on their source offers
Separate containers, reached over the network
PostgreSQL · Redis · MinIO (AGPL-3.0) · nginx · ClamAV · Prometheus · Grafana
their licences do not propagate, and ReView's does not reach them
